info.description: API tests for ItHelpDesk. Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner. Works on a fresh database and on re-runs. Requires the 'ItHelpDesk Local' environment.

item.name: Refresh Token Used As Access Token

exec:

pm.test("Deactivated user is kicked out at refresh", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.include("refresh token"));
